name: cobuilder-memory
title: A memory plugin reads and writes Hindsight at the moments that need it
outcome: A session that installs cobuilder-memory reads and writes Hindsight memory at the moments that need it. A router decides at each prompt and each stop. The design and build workflows call the plugin at fixed moments. Each run leaves a receipt.
done_when: A spike on Claude Code 2.1.296 passes the eleven checks in spike.md on their pass branches before any epic starts. S3 may pass through its chosen fallback.
`claude plugin validate` accepts plugins/cobuilder-memory, and `claude plugin test` passes its tests.
`uv run pytest tests -q` passes with the install-surface rule that ADR-0039 amends.
A prompt that the router labels recall gets a memory note before the person's next prompt, and a receipt records the run.
Every stop of the main loop, a /goal iteration included, runs the router once while Hindsight answers, and the receipt records its labels.
A change to a file in the automatic memory folder reaches Hindsight as one document per file by the next stop.
Design stage 0 and implement Gate 1 call the moment tool, and the build skill holds no H1 to H5 checkpoint.
Design stage 4, the Gate 1 approval, and each epic-design approval read their deep-run note, or write a gap line from contracts.md.
In the first three read-moment runs, at least one reading step cites a note, not the pending line.
Design-mode section 7.3 accepts a confirmed memory claim, and each decision that uses a memory claim carries a memory citation.
A recall after a run finds no text of a memory note in the bank.
The engineer marks the router labels in the first 20 receipts right or wrong. The router stays when 16 or more are right.
abort_if: The spike shows that $.model.fork or $.mcp.call cannot run from a timer that session.start started. The quick run then has no place to run.
The hooks API changes shape before the shipping build, so a call that this design names no longer exists. Spike S10 checks it at each build epic.
Hindsight writes a memory note back into the bank, and no guard can stop it.

min_work.derived_from: 3 districts (skills, scripts, docs), colliding ADRs 0016, 0017, 0025, 0035, 2 boundary rules (ADR-0025 install surface, generic stack card dependency rule)
min_work.note: A failed spike check returns the design to stage 3 before any epic starts.

rounds.note: Reviewer round on Haiku. The engineer chose N1 a, N2 a, N3 a, N4 a, and the 14 cosmetic fixes.
Reviewer round 2 on Haiku. The engineer kept M3 a (R2-1 a), chose the tool-less deep run as the S3 fallback (R2-2 a), and the 21 fixes.
